title: QuantReflex Coaching Institute
description: Schema for coaching institute documents in Firestore 'coachings' collection. Created via Super Admin Panel.

coachingId.description: Unique identifier for the coaching institute. Uppercase, underscore-separated. Example: 'IMS_NAGPUR_01'

name.description: Display name of the coaching institute. Example: 'IMS Nagpur'

studentCount.description: Number of students enrolled (aggregated). May require periodic sync.
